verdict.rationale: The evidence shows React supports TypeScript through @types/react and @types/react-dom, and that you can type component props. Nothing in the pack states which TypeScript versions are officially supported, and there is no compatibility matrix or support policy. A TypeScript version-support policy is a fair axis for a UI framework, so this is "none", not "na".

support.subject: As a developer, I know which TypeScript versions the framework officially supports so I can avoid compatibility breaks when upgrading either one
